Rava-Ruska Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · L'vivs'ka oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. Rava-Ruska's Jewish community dates to the city's founding in 1624. Remarkably, three separate Hasidic courts were founded here: one by Ihl-Ishiyagu Rapoport, active from 1892; and two more in the 1920s, by Arie-Leybush Rokeh and Sholom Rokeah. The ghetto established here in 1941 also imprisoned Jewish residents deported from Nemirov, Maheriv, Potelych, and other surrounding villages, documented elsewhere in this collection; by May 1942 it held 6,700 people. About 3,500 were deported to the Bełżec extermination camp in two actions that March and July, and the ghetto's liquidation on December 7, 1942, saw 3,000 more executed, with the remaining population deported to Bełżec or sent to labor camps.
